q: The Abramov formula relates the entropy of a flow to the entropy of its time-one map and the roof function. For a suspension flow over (X, T, μ) with constant roof function r:
exp: Abramov's theorem: for a suspension flow with integrable roof function r, h(φ_t) = h(T) / ∫r dμ. For constant roof r, this gives h = h(T)/r—entropy scales inversely with the suspension height.
